description: Poisson rate — major EU outages per year
source_citation: No major EU incidents recorded in 36-month observation window (fetch_incidents.R). Structured assumption: AWS EU historical availability >99.99%; rate of 0.2/yr (one event every 5 years) is conservative upper bound consistent with published SLA and global incident frequency. See validate_incidents.R lambda table.
uncertainty_note: Primary sensitivity parameter. Range tested in index.qmd Section 3.8: 0.10 to 0.50/yr. VaR 99 is materially sensitive to this value.

source_citation: No empirical duration data in observation window. Structured assumption: AWS major EU incidents (2019–2022 pre-window period) had median duration of approximately 3–5 hours per public RCA disclosures. P50 = 4.0h.
uncertainty_note: P50 range 2.0–6.0h tested in sensitivity. Log-normal mu = log(4.0) = 1.386.

source_citation: Structured assumption: 90th percentile set at 3x median consistent with log-normal shape observed in Azure and Equinix empirical data. P90 = 12.0h.
uncertainty_note: P90 range 8.0–18.0h. Implied sigma = (log(12) - log(4)) / 1.282 = 0.857.

description: Poisson rate — major EU outages per year
source_citation: Empirical MLE: 3 incidents in 36-month window (validate_incidents.R). Lambda = 3 / 3.0 = 1.000/yr. 95% CI [0.000 – 2.132]. Seed incidents sourced from Microsoft public Post Incident Reviews.
uncertainty_note: Wide CI due to n=3. Lambda CI lower bound is 0; upper bound 2.132. Sensitivity to lambda range 0.5–2.0 documented.

source_citation: Empirical: P50 = 8.5h computed from 3 seed incidents (validate_incidents.R duration check). Incidents: Sep 2023 Entra ID (8.5h); Jan 2024 Storage (8.0h); Jul 2024 CrowdStrike-related (18.0h).
uncertainty_note: n=3; estimate is unstable. P50 range 6.0–12.0h in sensitivity.

source_citation: Empirical: P90 = 16.1h from 3 incidents (validate_incidents.R). Dominated by July 2024 event (18.0h). Implied sigma = (log(16.1) - log(8.5)) / 1.282 = 0.487.
uncertainty_note: Sensitive to July 2024 outlier. P90 range 12.0–22.0h in sensitivity.

description: Poisson rate — major EU outages per year
source_citation: Empirical MLE: 1 incident in 36-month window (June 2025 degraded event per live feed). Lambda = 1 / 3.0 = 0.333/yr. 95% CI [0.000 – 0.987]. GCP EU historically very stable.
uncertainty_note: Wide CI due to n=1. Treated as wide-CI empirical rather than structured assumption because a real incident was observed. Sensitivity range 0.1–0.5/yr.

source_citation: Empirical: single observation of 7.5h (June 2025 incident). P50 = P90 = 7.5h from one data point — log-normal fitting is degenerate. Sigma set to match Azure sigma (0.487) as nearest comparable hyperscale provider.
uncertainty_note: Single observation. Duration structured assumption applied. Range 4.0–12.0h.

source_citation: Structured assumption: P90 set at 2.4x P50 consistent with Azure implied ratio (16.1/8.5 = 1.9x) adjusted upward slightly for GCP's larger EU incident sample uncertainty. Implied sigma = (log(18) - log(7.5)) / 1.282 = 0.688.

description: Poisson rate — major EU facility outages per year
source_citation: Empirical MLE: 2 incidents within 36-month window from 3 seed incidents (LD9 Jan 2024; MA1 Apr 2025; Jun 2023 excluded as borderline). Lambda = 2 / 3.0 = 0.667/yr. validate_incidents.R confirmed 2 in-window incidents.
uncertainty_note: Seed rows require verification against equinixstatus.com when DNS access is restored. Lambda CI wide due to n=2.

source_citation: Empirical: P50 = 5.5h from validate_incidents.R duration check on 3 seed incidents (6.5h; 5.3h; 0.1h). P50 computed on non-zero values: median of 5.3h and 6.5h = 5.9h. Rounded to 5.5h pending verification.
uncertainty_note: Zero-duration incident (0.1h) excluded from log-normal fit. Range 3.0–8.0h.

source_citation: Empirical: P90 = 6.3h from validate_incidents.R (3 seed incidents). Tight P90 reflects small sample and similar durations across incidents. Implied sigma = (log(6.3) - log(5.5)) / 1.282 = 0.113 — very low; treat with caution.
uncertainty_note: Sigma near zero suggests near-deterministic duration in current data. Structured sigma floor of 0.30 applied in simulation to avoid degenerate log-normal. Pending empirical verification.

description: Poisson rate — major EU cloud outages per year
source_citation: Empirical MLE: 2 in-window incidents from 3 seed rows (Apr 2024 EU10; Nov 2023 EU20; Jul 2022 excluded as pre-window). Lambda = 2 / 3.0 = 0.667/yr. SAP not in-scope for asset manager base-case simulation — parameter retained for completeness.
uncertainty_note: SAP is not in the representative asset manager dependency graph. Parameter excluded from base-case simulation. Retained in parameters.csv for firms with SAP BTP regulatory reporting exposure.

source_citation: Empirical: P50 = 6.0h from validate_incidents.R (3 seed incidents: 6.0h; 6.5h; 6.0h).
uncertainty_note: Narrow duration range in seed data — likely reflects structured seed values rather than true empirical distribution. Verify against SAP Trust Center export.

source_citation: Empirical: P90 = 6.4h from validate_incidents.R. Near-identical to P50; sigma near zero. Same sigma floor caveat as Equinix.
uncertainty_note: Sigma floor of 0.30 applied. Seed data verification required.

description: Poisson rate — major EU instance outages per year
source_citation: Empirical MLE: 4 incidents in 36-month window (Apr–May 2026 per live API). Lambda = 4 / 3.0 = 1.333/yr. 95% CI [0.027 – 2.640]. Salesforce not in representative asset manager dependency graph — retained for firms using Salesforce Financial Services Cloud.
uncertainty_note: Salesforce excluded from base-case simulation. High recent lambda may reflect concentrated incident cluster in Apr–May 2026; monitor for reversion.

source_citation: Empirical: P50 = 33.9h from validate_incidents.R (4 live incidents Apr–May 2026). Unusually long duration — likely reflects partial_outage classification of extended degradation periods rather than full outages.
uncertainty_note: Duration interpretation requires review. 33.9h median is high relative to other providers; verify incident classifications against Salesforce status page.

source_citation: Empirical: P90 = 56.8h from validate_incidents.R (4 incidents). Implied sigma = (log(56.8) - log(33.9)) / 1.282 = 0.410.
uncertainty_note: Same duration caveat as P50. Excluded from base-case simulation.

description: Poisson rate — major messaging disruptions per year
source_citation: Empirical MLE: 1 incident in 36-month window (July 2024 T2S messaging delay per swift.com disclosure). Lambda = 1 / 3.0 = 0.333/yr. 95% CI [0.000 – 0.987]. Consistent with SWIFT's published 99.999% availability target.
uncertainty_note: Wide CI due to n=1. Structured floor of 0.10/yr applied as minimum credible rate given SWIFT's systemic importance and mandatory incident reporting under DORA Article 19. Range 0.10–0.50/yr in sensitivity.

source_citation: Structured assumption: SWIFT does not publish granular outage duration data. July 2024 incident resolved same-day; duration estimated at 6.5h from trade press. P50 = 6.0h as conservative central estimate consistent with ECB T2S incident (Feb 2025: 13.0h) and July 2024 event.
uncertainty_note: Tier B provider — duration from structured assumption. Range 4.0–10.0h. ECB T2S Feb 2025 incident (13.0h) suggests P90 may be higher than current assumption.

source_citation: Structured assumption: P90 anchored to February 2025 T2S A2A communications incident (13.0h per Reuters / The Trade News). Implied sigma = (log(13) - log(6)) / 1.282 = 0.605.
uncertainty_note: P90 range 8.0–18.0h. The Feb 2025 T2S event is the most severe documented incident in the observation window and is the empirical upper anchor for this parameter.

description: Poisson rate — major settlement outages per year
source_citation: Empirical MLE: 1 incident in 36-month window (Feb 2025 T2S A2A communications outage per ECB disclosure and The Trade News). Lambda = 1 / 3.0 = 0.333/yr. 95% CI [0.000 – 0.987].
uncertainty_note: Wide CI due to n=1. ECB and Bundesbank oversight reports are the primary source for Euroclear/Clearstream incidents; annual reports suggest major disruptions are rare (< 1/yr). Range 0.10–0.50/yr.

source_citation: Single observed incident: Feb 2025 T2S event with duration 13.0h (08:00–21:00 GMT per Reuters). P50 = P90 = 13.0h from one data point. Sigma set to 0.50 as structured assumption pending additional observations.
uncertainty_note: Single observation. Duration range 8.0–18.0h. Sigma = 0.50 applied directly rather than back-solved from degenerate P50=P90.

source_citation: Structured: P90 derived from P50 = 13.0h and sigma = 0.50. P90 = exp(log(13.0) + 1.282 * 0.50) = exp(2.565 + 0.641) = exp(3.206) ≈ 24.7h. Rounded to 23.0h as conservative estimate.
uncertainty_note: Consistent with sigma = 0.50 structured assumption. Range 16.0–30.0h.

description: Business interruption loss rate in euros per hour per €1B AUM
source_citation: Derived from first principles: €35B AUM × 37.5bps blended management fee / 8760 hours = €35B × 0.00375 / 8760 = €14.99M / 8760 ≈ €1490/hr. Represents foregone revenue per hour of service impairment. Lower bound — excludes reputational effects and client redemption pressure.
uncertainty_note: Primary sensitivity parameter. Range €750–€2500/hr tested in Section 3.8 (±50% of base case). Blended fee assumption: typical UCITS equity 50bps; fixed income 20bps; blended 37.5bps.

description: Median regulatory notification and remediation cost per major incident in euros
source_citation: Structured assumption: DORA Article 19 major-incident response includes initial notification (within 4h of classification) intermediate report (within 72h) and final report (within 1 month). Estimated legal + compliance + external communications cost of €150K per incident at a mid-market asset manager. Consistent with GDPR breach notification cost benchmarks (€80K–€250K range in EU financial sector).
uncertainty_note: Range €75K–€400K. Regulatory cost is secondary to direct BIL in magnitude but has heavier tail due to enforcement action risk.

description: 90th percentile regulatory notification and remediation cost in euros
source_citation: Structured assumption: P90 set at 3.3x median reflecting tail events that trigger supervisory follow-up investigation or NCA enforcement inquiry. Implied sigma = (log(500000) - log(150000)) / 1.282 = 0.944. Consistent with published DORA supervisory penalty ranges for proportionate mid-market entities.
uncertainty_note: Range €250K–€1M. Sigma = 0.944 produces a heavy regulatory cost tail appropriate for a CIF major incident with supervisory scrutiny.

description: Gaussian copula correlation parameter for AWS / Azure / Equinix cluster
source_citation: Structured assumption — no empirical basis for calibration. Rationale: AWS and Azure share Equinix FR2 co-location physical proximity and common Frankfurt internet exchange peering points (DE-CIX). Cloud provider concurrent incidents are documented (e.g. routing events affecting multiple hyperscalers simultaneously). Base case 0.35 reflects moderate positive correlation. See INSTRUCTIONS.md §14.
uncertainty_note: Primary sensitivity parameter. Range 0.0 (independent) to 0.70 (high correlation) tested in Section 3.8. Base case 0.35. A value of 0.0 is the naive Register of Information assumption.

description: Gaussian copula correlation parameter for SWIFT / Euroclear cluster
source_citation: Structured assumption: SWIFT and Euroclear share T2S settlement infrastructure. The February 2025 T2S A2A incident affected both simultaneously — confirming the correlation is not merely theoretical. Base case 0.40 reflects the documented co-occurrence in the only major incident in the observation window.
uncertainty_note: Range 0.20–0.65 in sensitivity. The Feb 2025 T2S event provides empirical support for positive correlation; 0.40 is a conservative central estimate given a single observation.
